result.task:
Investigate why KalshiML shows "no_ensemble_yet" for NYC HIGH contracts.

Focus ONLY on these 3 files: run_ensemble_search.py, ensemble_optimizer.py, and daily_part_06.py.
Read each one, identify what triggers "no_ensemble_yet", and report the root cause in 2-3 sentences.

Do NOT read any other files. Do NOT check issues or logs. Do NOT modify anything.
result.final_answer:
**Root cause (2-3 sentences):**

Consumers of the ensemble config load `ensemble_champions.json` (CHAMPION_CONFIG_PATH in ensemble_optimizer.py) and emit `"no_ensemble_yet"` when there is no champion entry for a given city/variable/lead bucket — i.e., NYC HIGH temperature has no champion config recorded. That entry is missing because the optimizer never produced one for that bucket (insufficient settled prevruns/truth data for NYC HIGH to score any grouping), and it persists because `run_ensemble_search.py` short-circuits with exit code 1 ("No new data since last run") whenever the prevruns archive mtime is ≤ the last optimizer run timestamp, so `run_optimizer` is never invoked to fill the gap.
